data.name: field
data.shape: FieldResult — stats, agents[], vendors[], ownAgents[], shown, generatedAt | unreadable
data.source: app.readField.execute — the denominator every other performance figure lacks

data.name: leaderboard
data.source: same query; fails independently of the field

data.name: window / sort
data.source: searchParams, validated against FIELD_WINDOWS / FIELD_SORTS; an unrecognised value falls back and is never forwarded

components.purpose: Who else is doing this and how it is going for them — the denominator for every unanchored figure elsewhere.
components.current_implementation: max-w-3xl centered column, space-y-6, p-6. Standing and field fail independently — an outage produces one sentence per failure, never two about the same one.
constraints: Reads only — the page says so and it must stay true.
Unread and unplaced must not read alike — one is about the platform, the other about this account's results (WhyNotLoaded carries the distinction).
Only the platform's own enums reach the adapter; an unrecognised URL value falls back rather than being forwarded.

components.purpose: Where this account sits: rank, percentile, profit — or the honest absence of a placement.
components.current_implementation: One sentence per state; unreadable carries role=alert plus WhyNotLoaded. Percentile and value render only when the platform measured them.
constraints: Unplaced ('BattleGrid does not place this account yet') is a fact about results, unreadable is a fact about the platform — the two sentences must stay distinct.
A missing rate or value renders as absent, never as zero.

components.purpose: The rows the rank is a rank among, with this account's row marked in words.
components.current_implementation: Ordered list; the own row is font-medium plus '— this account', matched on userId presence and equality only. Rendered only when the standing was readable.
constraints: The own row is marked by words and weight, never colour alone.
Matched on the platform's id and nothing else — two unidentified rows must never both read as yours.
Empty renders 'ranks no players in this window', never a blank list.

components.purpose: Re-ask the question: window and sort, from the platform's enums, into the query string.

actions.effect: GET form — the field re-renders for the chosen window and sort; the URL is shareable

components.current_implementation: Two selects (LABEL/CONTROL) and a BUTTON_SECONDARY 'Apply' in a flex-wrap row.
constraints: A GET form — nothing is written; the composed question lives in the URL.

components.purpose: The field's rows: every rate beside its trade count, every card opening into the agent behind it.
components.current_implementation: Heading counts rows shown, never the field. DT-0008: cards wear rounded-gc-2 border-border-default p-3 (the precedent for #155's sweep); the partial-field sentence wears the notice role; the win-rate caveat is plain text-text-secondary prose.
constraints: The heading counts rendered rows; the field total is stated separately — the list is sometimes shorter than the field and no moment may assume it whole.
Every win rate prints beside its trade count — sorting by rate promotes the smallest sample.
A rate the platform did not measure renders 'not measured', never 0%.
Losses read as losses at a glance (signed money).
The platform's own subtitle/objective sentences render unparaphrased.

components.purpose: Which vendors' agents are actually making money, across everyone who runs them.
components.current_implementation: Plain list: provider, agent count, trades, win rate, net — same never-zero rate discipline.
constraints: Rendered only when the platform returned vendors.

components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component; treatment owned by DT-0006.

flows.name: Anchor a judgment
steps: find the account's standing among the rows
open a leader's card to see what they do

flows.name: Re-ask
steps: the same page for a different question, in a shareable URL

accessibility.notes: Unreadable states carry role=alert. The own row is legible without colour. No client JS.
